title.en: Tale 12 — The Hare and the Lion

sentences.ar: أسد كان ياكل من حيوانات الغابة كل يوم.
sentences.en: A lion used to eat from the forest animals every day.

sentences.ar: اتفقوا يبعتوا له واحد كل يوم لحاله.
sentences.en: They agreed to send him one each day by itself.
The turn came to a small, clever hare.

sentences.ar: قال للأسد: في أسد تاني بالغابة أخذ أكلي.
sentences.en: He said to the lion: there is another lion in the forest who took my food.

sentences.ar: ودّاه على بير عميق وقال: هو تحت.
sentences.en: He led him to a deep well and said: he is down there.

sentences.ar: الأسد شاف خياله بالمي وحسبه عدو.
sentences.en: The lion saw his reflection in the water and thought it an enemy.
He jumped at it and never came out.
